outcomeLegend.error: Runtime or validation error before a scored result
outcomeLegend.timeout: Configured test timeout; elapsed time may exceed the deadline

costBasis: Per-call model-token estimates including reported cache usage. Same cases within each web/no-web comparison; excludes missing usage, no-model cases, Firecrawl fees, and provider adjustments. Web and no-web cost subsets differ.
evidenceSetup: Public fixture catalog adapters. Web runs started with separate empty auto-replay directories per setting; new tool requests were live and identical requests could replay. No production catalog writes.
limitations: One full-suite attempt per setting is not a reliable production accuracy estimate.
Model, retrieval, cache, and timing variability were uncontrolled; suites ran concurrently.
Some fixtures conflict with current policy or use strict field snapshots; preserve these measured outcomes when reviewing the rubric.
Targeted repeats were selected after inspecting failures and cannot estimate overall accuracy.
